snippet.title: On Grid Solar System को Hybrid में Convert करने का खर्चा  | Power Cut में भी बिजली मिलेगी
snippet.description:
On Grid Solar System को Hybrid में Convert करने का खर्चा  | Power Cut में भी बिजली मिलेगी
 
https://solartrixcrm.mymonitrix.in/solar/lead-form.html?ref=ENGINEERBharat

If you are struggling with power cuts and already have an on-grid solar system at home, this information may help you. Most government subsidy schemes usually support on-grid solar systems because they are cheaper. For example, a 5 kW on-grid system generally costs around ₹2.8 lakh, and after a subsidy of ₹78,000, the final cost becomes about ₹2 lakh.

However, in areas with frequent electricity cuts, on-grid systems fail to provide backup power. In such cases, a hybrid solar system is needed. The video explains how an existing on-grid system can be upgraded to a hybrid system.

An EPC vendor from a solar company explained a real customer case:

▸ The customer originally installed a 3 kW on-grid solar system under the PM Surya Ghar Yojana.
▸ The installation cost was around ₹1.85 lakh.
▸ Since the house was in a village with frequent power cuts, the customer faced problems because the solar system could not provide electricity during outages.
▸ Later, the customer upgraded the system from a 3 kW on-grid setup to a 5 kW hybrid system because of increased electricity load and the need for 24-hour power backup.

The total cost after customization and upgrade was around ₹3.95 lakh. Generally, a 5 kW hybrid system starts from about ₹3 lakh and can go up to ₹4 lakh depending on customization.

The system used a UTL hybrid inverter and UTL batteries with a 5-year warranty. Some key features mentioned were:

▸ Option to disable battery charging from the grid to reduce electricity bills.
▸ Optional Wi-Fi monitoring feature.
▸ Display screen, LED indicators, and customization buttons.
▸ Battery display and communication ports.
▸ Support for parallel battery connections.
▸ Compatibility with modern hybrid inverter technology.

The vendor also said that if someone already has a 5 kW on-grid system installed by any company, it can be converted into a hybrid system for approximately ₹1 lakh.

The video ends by inviting viewers to contact the company for upgrades and ask questions in the comments.
